annotation.title_clean: Se aprobó la Estrategia Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial 2024 - 2030
annotation.title_en: The National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2024-2030 has been approved
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agesic (Agencia de Gobierno Electrónico y Sociedad de la Información y del Conocimiento), Uruguay
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Agesic news item announcing that Uruguay's Strategic Committee approved the National AI Strategy 2024-2030 on 21 November 2024. Developed participatively with CAF and UNESCO support under Law 20.212, it sets guiding principles and three objectives: governance, capacities, and sustainable development.
key_provisions_or_claims: Strategy approved 21 Nov 2024 by the Strategic Public Sector Committee for AI and Data
Developed under article 74 of Law 20.212 with CAF and UNESCO technical cooperation
Participatory process with 300+ people from state, civil society, private sector and academia
Objective 1: governance framework for ethical, responsible, safe AI
Objectives 2 and 3: national capacities and AI for sustainable development
